stages.instructions: Ask one unresolved creative question at a time. Clarify shaking and obtain a real hook/value example before prescribing the performance. Idk delegates a creative choice; it does not create missing footage.
Pair each text or number state with its meaning and intended reaction; establish the order without assuming numeric increase or emotional escalation.
Use supplied footage or provide a performance plan. Do not claim recording has occurred without a real source.
Use available editing tools; set readable holds and match each state to its reaction. Resolve music and optional effects before adding them. Do not claim an export if only a plan is possible.
Check readability, context changes, synchronization and the ending; report checks that were not performed.

note: Workflow operations are design descriptions, not installed commands or an implemented renderer.
